newsitem.title: USA: Buenos Aires issues 150 mln pesos in Eurobonds.
newsitem.headline: Buenos Aires issues 150 mln pesos in Eurobonds.

text.p: The following 144A Eurobond issue from the City of Buenos Aires, Argentina was priced on Monday, according to an emerging markets syndicate source.
Underwriters and the city agreed to issue the debt off a $500 million Euro medium-term note program on Monday morning. The issue was two times oversubscribed, the source said.
Chase Securities was lead manager on the deal.
